featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Pargaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Second Home, Not Just a School

Our Beautiful Journey with Peek a Boo
Sending your 14-month-old baby out into the world for the first time is one of the most nerve-wracking experiences for a parent. You wonder: Will they be safe? Will someone understand their babbles? Will they be loved? From the very first week at Peek a Boo Wadala, every single one of those worries completely melted away.
For almost two beautiful years, right up until he completed Nursery, this wonderful school was the absolute highlight of his day. Even though he was only there for a short two hours each morning, the impact it had on his growth was immense.
The true heartbeat of Peek a Boo is its incredible staff. The Maushis are absolute angels—they took care of all the needs of the children with the kind of gentle, maternal warmth that you usually only see at home. I still remember the early days of anxious drop-offs, which so quickly turned into him eagerly running inside because he couldn't wait to see his teachers and friends.
I owe a massive, heartfelt thank you to Roopa Teacher and Purvi Teacher. They have given so much to my child. You didn’t just teach him his colors and ABCs; you taught him how to be independent and confident. Under their patient guidance, I watched my tiny toddler learn to happily mix up and share with other children. They taught him the little joys of structure—like proudly putting away his shoes or sitting beautifully with his classmates during circle time. Their capability to manage, guide, and inculcate early learning skills in such young toddlers is truly unmatched.
As a parent, the greatest luxury you can have is peace of mind. Knowing my child was in such a safe, joyous, and capable space meant that once he was through those doors, I didn't need to worry at all. It is a secure, nurturing haven where children truly love to learn.
Saying goodbye after two years was genuinely emotional for us. Peek a Boo Wadala didn’t just prepare my son for big school; they gave him a childhood full of happy, secure memories. To the entire team: thank you for loving him like your own.
